title: 2023 International Olympic Committee's (IOC) consensus statement on Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport (REDs)
claims: REDs is defined as a syndrome of impaired physiological and/or psychological functioning caused by exposure to problematic low energy availability.
Secondary amenorrhoea, defined as the absence of 3 to 11 consecutive menstrual cycles caused by functional hypothalamic amenorrhoea, is listed as a primary indicator of REDs.
Primary amenorrhoea is listed as a severe primary indicator, counting as two primary indicators.
Menstrual dysfunction is one of several body systems affected by low energy availability, alongside bone, metabolic, immune, cardiovascular and psychological outcomes.

verification.checkedVia: bjsm.bmj.com 文章页、IOC 托管 PDF 与 IOC 官方 REDs CAT2 v2
verification.note: 文章正文读到定义、LEA 概念与患病率；指标表所在页因 Cloudflare 验证与 PDF 提取截断未直接取到，指标条款改以 IOC 官方 REDs CAT2 v2（该文件明示依据 2023 共识制定）核对。

claimVerification.note: 定义原文："a syndrome of impaired physiological and/or psychological functioning experienced by female and male athletes that is caused by exposure to problematic (prolonged and/or severe) low energy availability"；claim 仅省略人群与“持续/严重”限定，未外扩。
IOC REDs CAT2 v2 原文列于 "Primary Indicators (1 point)"："Secondary amenorrhea (females: absence of 3 to 11 consecutive menstrual cycles) caused by FHA"。
IOC REDs CAT2 v2 将 "Primary amenorrhea (females: failure to reach menarche by age 15 ...)" 列于 "Severe Primary Indicators (2 points)"，即计两项。

共识定义列出受影响系统："decreases in energy metabolism, reproductive function, musculoskeletal health, immunity, glycogen synthesis and cardiovascular and haematological health" 及心理功能；月经功能对应 reproductive function/menstrual indicators，未超出原文范围。
